summary_1line: Vishnu as the cosmic Boar destroys the Danavas, after which a dialogue begins on the supreme yoga and Vasudeva as the ultimate reality.

image_candidates.scene_text: The colossal boar-form of Vishnu stands amid the netherworld, surrounded by thousands of Danavas struggling to drag him from all sides.
Vishnu in boar form unleashes a thunderous roar that freezes gods and demons alike as the universe trembles.
A devoted disciple stands with folded hands at his radiant preceptor’s feet, asking about the origin of the self and the path to emancipation.
